description: Preferred default for device-focused requests to view one device's details, status, or energy charts. Render a read-only SunSaver, SunMini, SunCharger, SunHeater, or Shelly Plug detail dashboard with the Android app's supported chart periods. A site_id supplies device context and does not imply a site dashboard; do not call get_site_dashboard for a device-only request. If the user explicitly asks for both site-level information and device details, return both the site and device panels. Always call this before raw detail/history tools unless the user explicitly asks for raw JSON. Falls back to a compact text card when the MCP host cannot render Apps.
name: get_device_dashboard
title: 设备详情仪表盘
